verdict.rationale: Persona ships a well-documented REST API covering inquiries, verifications, reports, workflows, accounts, and webhooks, with a dedicated API reference, sandbox testing mode, and even an llms.txt AI-agent guidance file confirming programmatic/documented access. missing for 10: independent third-party developer accounts of API usage beyond Persona's own docs, and no explicit API versioning/rate-limit/authentication deep-dive in the pack.
